rationale.A: Eläintarha path and Töölönlahti, but drops onto Helsinginkatu and Pasilansilta in traffic (~180 m); 1 light
rationale.B: Path along the railway then Kaisaniemi park; no mixed traffic, 0 lights, same time as A
rationale.C: Same Töölönlahti line as A but over Linnunlaulu bridge, no traffic; +2 min
rationale.D: Central Park/Hammarskjöldintie then Töölönlahti; no traffic but 4 lights
rationale.E: Pasilankatu and Pasilansilta (tram) in traffic, Nordenskiöldinkatu side path; 7 lights
rationale.F: Kotkankatu/Tivolitie quiet streets, Aleksis Kiven katu side path, Töölönlahti; 2 lights
rationale.G: Porvoonkatu (tram) and Wallininkatu in traffic through Alppila; 5 lights
rationale.H: Railway path then Siltasaari side tracks, short Porthaninrinne in traffic; 3 lights

notes: B removes A's arterial bit (Helsinginkatu/Pasilansilta) at no time cost. That is a small share, but it is free, so B is picked for calm. Fewest lights: A has only 1.
